sloka: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा गुणदोषौ विमृश्य च ।पश्चादपि महाबाहो शत्रून् युधि विजेष्यसि ।। ६.६०.८३ ।।।।
transliteration: rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā guṇadoṣau vimṛśya ca ।paścādapi mahābāho śatrūn yudhi vijeṣyasi ।। 6.60.83 ।।।।

translations.english: After rousing up Kumbhakarna of frightful eyes and fierce strength from sleep the Rakshasas quickly went to the abode of the ten headed king.
